- Pathbox suggestions don't work
- Clicking on pathbox items doesn't work

- Those `public static event`s (@5879)
- ....

I'm sorry to see the "show preview only" option go away, for PDFs for e.g the preview is really small. Would you consider to implement the feature as follows (notice the collapse button)?

At least some of these should be somewhat simple, I'll try implementing them.

> Would you consider to implement the feature as follows (notice the collapse button)?

yeah sure, I didn't think there was demand for this. Also an expand button is a really good idea.

Instead of a collapse details button, what about clicking on the grid splitter to automatically collapse the details section (after it's collapsed, an expand button can be shown in case the user want's to view the details again)?
What about making the preview image clickable, to show and hide the details?

> What about making the preview image clickable, to show and hide the details?

That's also an option, and we could probably use the expand button with that design as well to show the details section.

I though the grid splitter was supposed to be removed?

> What about making the preview image clickable, to show and hide the details?

The issue with this is that some previews, particularly text, html, and video previews, are interactive, so expanding/collapsing on click would interfere with normal usage.

> I though the grid splitter was supposed to be removed?

@winston-de I guess you're right. I think we should hold off on this for now so we can get the PR merged.
Can the right click menu option be kept until the design is decided?

@winston-de sure.

> > Please don't keep the title in the center while other details left aligned. > > @Jaiganeshkumaran like this? I think it looks a bit better, @yaichenbaum what do you think? > I think the centered design will look better once the rest of the items in the preview pane are centered as well.

issue_context.title: Preview Pane only shows the item selected in the first column of ColumnView
issue_context.body:
### Description

This issue also relates to a previous design issue I've raised (https://github.com/files-community/Files/issues/5880) as it's not clear in Column View what the active selection is.

---

While it's clear Files has an internal indication on what the "active" and selected items are as QuickLook and Delete functions work off this, but that isn't reflected in the Preview Pane which will only show:

1) Items selected in the first column.
2) The open folder of the first column.

### Steps To Reproduce

Select any item not in the first column with the Preview Pane open.

![Screenshot 2021-08-21 145016](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9108903/130325657-272f4c6c-7dea-487a-a263-9b837a9c0bb6.png)


### Expected behavior

The Preview Pane should show the most recently selected item no matter what column it is in.

### Files Version

Version: 1.9.25.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 Pro 21H2 22000.160

### Relevant Assets

_No response_
